notes: Both live branches came from the same isolated copy of the old Tine arrival. The test fixture adds 70 drams, two timber, two oak stakes and one hatchet before the actual common movement. Native selection, paid trade and consumption perform the remaining changes.

The contract per-item shop initially listed the four-fish stack at 57 drams. The ordinary quantity-trade mode bought one for 15, without selling other stock. The manual leg used the same quantity method and paid 14.
